description: Pinned availability is cPanel 110+. Observed: Reviewer 5721328890 on cPanel 11.138.0.19 reports all six Nova reads they called failed on both routes because Cpanel::API::Nova could not load. Reviewer-source inspection found the module file absent. All eleven methods are unavailable for verification on this server. Write failures are expected from the missing module but were not executed. Every Nova response shape, including overlay repairs, remains unobserved. Policy: Each call makes one request without automatic retry, polling, rollback or undo. Returned tokens, SSO URLs and account metadata are sensitive payload data. The client does not fetch returned URLs or inspect website files. API success does not establish publication completion, rendering or interactive SSO login.
